q: What if I already have a website?
a: We start by reviewing it. Content improvements, a better mobile layout or a dedicated campaign page may be enough. If a new site makes sense, I’ll explain why.
We begin with a conversation and a written proposal. The schedule depends on the scope and materials. You review a working version, we complete the agreed revisions and launch after your approval.

q: Are ads included in the build?
a: Website & ads and Website & custom tools include initial setup of one channel within the stated scope. Monthly management is separate. Ad spend is paid directly to Google or Meta.

q: Do you guarantee rankings or enquiry numbers?
a: No. Demand, competition, your offer and budget all affect the outcome. We agree the work and measurement before starting, then choose the next steps using the available information.

q: Who owns the domain and advertising accounts?
a: You do. At handover you receive the agreed access, documentation and instructions.
